description: Unofficial Korbat fan-art companion from Neopets. Original pale bat artwork with two red membrane wings, large pink-inner ears and one arrow-tip tail. Korbat presents a paper tag, turns its ears beside a soft paper bell, flutters over a paper circle, and flies in three directions with visible wingbeats. Rounded wing-thumb gripping and friendly paper props are original cartoon adaptations.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
